title: The Biggest ChatGPT Mistake #chatgptprompts #aipromptengineering #promptingtips
description:
Most people use ChatGPT all wrong — they ask vague questions and accept average answers. Treat the AI like you’re hiring an assistant: don’t say “write a report” and expect brilliance. Give context, constraints, tone, purpose. Tell ChatGPT who it is, what role to play, who the audience is, and the outcome you want. Include examples, desired length, and a deadline. Small details change everything. Think of prompts as briefings and the AI will perform like a trained employee. Start giving clear instructions and watch the quality skyrocket. Follow HeadlessHub for more practical AI hacks.
